about:
I'm a builder and entrepreneur. 
 
Over the past six years, I've built two businesses from scratch. At Makalu Health, I went from idea to working AI product in months, designing and building AMY, the first-of-its-kind AI recruiting agentic platform that automates physician matching, sourcing and engagement for the notoriously slow locum tenens market. I've worn every hat from product management, operations, sales and design. We achieved a 30% increase in placements, with no added recruiter or sourcing specialist headcount for our mid-sized locum clients. 

At Techsensus, I founded an 8(a)-certified federal staffing firm, won government contracts with Health and Human Services and DoD, managed live clinical placements, learning the hard way how healthcare delivery actually works on the ground. Techsensus is one of the premier and largest clients providing state-of-the-art healthcare services to the Native American population in the most remote parts of the United States, including the Sioux and Navajo population. Since founding, the company has generated over $20M in revenue. 

Currently, open to advisory roles: If you're building something ambitious, let's talk.
